text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the midway point of the camp, first-timers reach
the peak of their exhaustion.
Many see an extreme drop in performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Securing an additional training spot elsewhere
and utilizing both improved her performance, but—
choice_data_list: Look at the time, shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I've concentrated my running sessions in the mornings and evenings.
Factoring in travel time... I have to run even more—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't... get stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if we optimize the environment, stress will gradually accumulate.
Leaving it unchecked will inevitably cause problems down the line.
Improving the environment alone has its limits. In the end—
choice_data_list: We've got to find a way to get her a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking wisdom from someone experienced with camp,
I contacted Air Groove, who was at the academy
on student council business, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
âA refresh, huh?
In that case, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's a festival held every year not far from the training lodge.
It should serve as a brief breather for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The problem is... how to get Alv out...
choice_data_list: If only we could make it a recreation activity everyone can join...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If it's an official event, then that one will have no choice but to participate, too, huh... It's worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Recreation...? A festival...?
Am... am I going to that too?
choice_data_list: Stress relief is an important part of the program, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With Air Groove's help, we were able to have the Student Council host this appreciation event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since every camp attendee had to participate, the other Umamusume got to enjoy the exact same benefits.
As a proposal, it went through without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And? What specifically
do you want me to do?
choice_data_list: Playing festival games as a team

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I show her the flyer for the recreational event.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(......"Enjoy festival games to the fullest!
Clear them to win amazing prizes!"...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't really care about the prize, but...
Well, alright.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, once I clear one activity, may I return to the training camp lodge?
All I need to do is play, correct?
choice_data_list: Well... I suppose so. That's fine with me.
Well... I guess so. I don't mind that at all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's go with that, then.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please rest assured. Alv-san's partner is
none other than myself, Saint Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: As her well-acquainted roommate, now is the time for me to be of help to Alv-san...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes!
For this, too, is a saint's duty...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (If it's my roommate, it might be a bit easier to handle... The point is just to clear it quickly.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
――... Whatever it is,
let's just get it over with quickly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sending the students off to the festival game stalls.
What was proposed to Admire Groove and the others was—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: In short, I just need to throw this ball and hit the 9 panels, correct?
choice_data_list: Yeah, 9 cards between the two of us, but... it's tough
Yeah, it's 9 cards between the two of us, but... it's tough.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is it difficult?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text: Ah, after all, the panel is over there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It's quite far, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
The target for Umamusume is 40 meters away!
You girls have outstanding reflexes, after all!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall go first.
Allow me to show you the true power of a saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Not a single hit landed...?
What a daunting trial...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally, trying to hit a target while flying
over such a long distance is quite difficult...)
May I throw a pitch?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: KABLAMMM...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ball landed right next to the target and burst.
Immediately after, the shockwave and roar swept through, blowing away the target that wasn't supposed to be hit.

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text: Huh...... Whaaat......?
choice_data_list: (So a ball can make a sound like that...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That panel...
Isn't it a bit slovenly?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine.
I've cleared it now, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess wind pressure doesn't count... haha.
The ball... didn't actually hit, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... What an inflexible ruling.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You are the only one who would defy common sense like that.
Allow me to show you how it's done properly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The only downside is that the ball is a bit on the large side...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With pinpoint accuracy,
Verxina knocked down all 9 panels in just 9 throws.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: As long as your pivot foot and body movement—your core—stays stable, the rest is just distance control. Well, that's about it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Both of you are truly incredible...!
How did you learn to do that?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you think every day about how to use every muscle in your body
and how to transfer power, you can apply it to anything.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—If one has honed oneself to the absolute peak...
something of this level is mere child's play.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What immense pride
she holds in her own abilities...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—We cannot afford to lose either.
Let us join forces and overcome this trial!”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Neither of them relied in the slightest on help from the other.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(It means she fought using only
what she forged and sculpted with her own two hands.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (As I thought, the only thing I can rely on... is my own power...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll clear it on my own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...I need to calm down.
The ball is at least reaching around the target.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Then after that, it's probably just a matter of form.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Hips, shoulders, elbows, wrists... Coordinate everything, and the form to send it flying straight is—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
!
That's wonderful form...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —8 left. I will knock them down with my own strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove cleared the target practice flawlessly and returned to the training camp lodge.
choice_data_list: I hope that was a nice change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I do not know.
However, I did learn a thing or two.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have an early start tomorrow, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's unclear if she managed to relax,
but she seems to have gained something from it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...There's no such thing as 'easy' or 'hard' when it comes to goldfish scooping.

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text: Naive. These goldfish are battle-hardened veterans who've never once let a single scoop touch them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! So capturing these little ones will be "next to impossible"—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: In other words, this is... an ordeal...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Looks like this... isn't going to stop...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah...! You noticed me again...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
These goldfish are battle-hardened veterans... I can't even graze one.
This won't be a walk in the park...
...Could you be quiet for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text: ...That young lady over there has been standing completely still in the corner for about 10 minutes now...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
My goldfish is...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Such splendid handiwork...!
Is there a trick to it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Who knows...? But if you're thinking unnecessary thoughts,
your behavior will become erratic.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Things like that always show in the results.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: In other words... my worldly thoughts were disrupting... my powers as a saintly maiden...?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...If you are wavering with idle thoughts, then simply
set your mind firmly upon a single thing."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Geez, Ayabe-san, going on ahead by yourself.
What about goldfish scooping—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've already cleared it.
Let's go buy some cotton candy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on, Ayabe-san!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. U-Umm...
Both of you, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (......Focus on just one...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me, could I get one as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And about 15 minutes passed—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Brilliant, Alv-san...!
I can't afford to fall behind...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having cleared her mind of all distractions,
Admire Groove successfully scooped up a goldfish and returned.
choice_data_list: I hope that was a nice change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Well... who can say?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "However, right now, I felt that I should clear my mind of all distractions and focus on just one thing..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Tomorrow starts early, so I'll be leaving now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's unclear whether she truly felt refreshed,
but she seemed to have successfully shifted her mindset.
